cell_indexing: All source cells use zero-based indexing in the original assessment notebook.

assessment_1.description: Original Assessment 1 executed notebook. Substantive cells are consolidated into notebooks/oregano-study.ipynb with original-source and original-cell metadata.

assessment_2.description: Original Assessment 2 canonical code notebook. Substantive cells are consolidated into notebooks/oregano-study.ipynb with original-source and original-cell metadata.

method: Extracted saved tables, text outputs, and embedded vis.DataSet arrays without rerunning the original analyses.
coverage_caveat: Saved node counts are preserved. The original cell 36 SELECT lacks DISTINCT; ratios derived here are descriptive and require a corrected query for independent validation.
label_correction: Disease IDs and their saved UMLS values are primary. Corrected labels were verified during public-release preparation; original prose labels remain alongside them in bayesian_rankings.csv.
ranking_caveat: Only the saved top-three raw counts are exported. No full posterior trace or verified denominator is available. These are model-dependent sample counts, not clinical probabilities.
candidate_path_caveat: The indication-code agreement recovers recorded indication associations. These pairs have not been independently clinically validated for this edition; the matching codes are not evidence of novel drug repurposing.
visualizations: Graph node/edge arrays exported from the saved HTML. Colours and layout are reformatted by build_visuals.py; biological assertions are preserved.

figures.candidate_paths: candidate_paths.csv and exported compound graph arrays
figures.trioxide_paths: trioxide_candidate_paths.csv; Assessment 2 cell 35 and read-only saved OWL edge checks

compound_id_mapping: NPASS values linked to ontology IDs by read-only saved OWL record lookup during publication review.
